provenance.quote: A seat-belt monitoring system comprising:
a first self-driving vehicle configured to transport a rider;
a first seat coupled to the first self-driving vehicle;
a first seat belt configured to secure the rider in the first seat;
configured to detect at least one of a buckled state of the first seat belt and an unbuckled state of the first seat belt
a first occupancy sensor configured to detect the rider sitting in the first seat;
a computer system comprising at least one computer and located remotely relative to the first self-driving vehicle,
the computer system comprises a memory having a buckling history of the rider
first program instructions configured to send a first wireless communication to the computer system
configured to determine a future transportation price for a ride at least partially based on the buckling history of the rider
third program instructions configured to send a second wireless communication to a remote computing device of the rider
fourth program instructions configured to deny a future ride request from the rider
camera configured to take a picture of the rider in the first seat during the unbuckled state
a second self-driving vehicle having a second seat belt and a second seat belt sensor
configured to detect at least one of a buckled state of the second seat belt and an unbuckled state of the second seat belt
configured to detect at least one of a buckled state of the second seat belt and an unbuckled state of the second seat belt
second program instructions configured to send a second wireless communication to the computer system
first weight sensor configured to detect first data indicative of a first weight of the rider sitting in the first seat
second weight sensor configured to detect second data indicative of a second weight of an unknown rider sitting in the second seat
configured to transport a rider
configured to secure the rider in the first seat

functionalities.text: detect a buckled or unbuckled state

provenance.quote: configured to detect at least one of a buckled state of the first seat belt and an unbuckled state of the first seat belt
configured to detect the rider sitting in the first seat
the computer system comprises a memory having a buckling history of the rider
configured to determine a future transportation price for a ride at least partially based on the buckling history of the rider
first program instructions configured to send a first wireless communication to the computer system
third program instructions configured to send a second wireless communication to a remote computing device of the rider

functionalities.text: warn the rider of a fine

provenance.quote: configured to warn the rider of a fine for the unbuckled state of the first seat belt
third program instructions configured to update the buckling history in response to receiving the first wireless communication
fourth program instructions configured to deny a future ride request from the rider
camera configured to take a picture of the rider in the first seat during the unbuckled state
first program instructions are configured to send a second wireless communication comprising the picture to the computer system

functionalities.text: receive identification and record rider sitting

provenance.quote: configured to receive an identification of the rider and record that the rider is sitting in the first seat
second program instructions are configured to determine that the unknown rider is the rider in response to comparing the second data to the first data

functionalities.text: determine future transportation price for ride in second vehicle

provenance.quote: second program instructions are configured to determine the future transportation price for the ride in a second self-driving vehicle
third program instructions are configured to charge the transportation price to an account of the rider

functionalities.text: increase future transportation price in response to buckling history indicating unbuckled state of first seat belt

provenance.quote: configured to increase the future transportation price in response to the buckling history indicating the unbuckled state of the first seat belt

functionalities.text: increase future transportation price in response to buckling history indicating unbuckled state of second seat belt

provenance.quote: configured to increase the future transportation price in response to the buckling history indicating an unbuckled state of a second seat belt

functionalities.text: prompt rider to buckle seat belt

provenance.quote: configured to prompt the rider to place the first seat belt in the buckled state

functionalities.text: send a second wireless communication to computer system in response to second seat belt sensor detecting unbuckled state

provenance.quote: configured to send a second wireless communication to the computer system in response to the second seat belt sensor detecting the unbuckled state
